title: Figure 2: Deuterium-Palladium TCP Equilibrium Diagram (pressure vs. D/Pd ratio)
description: Log-scale chart titled "Deuterium-Palladium TCP Equilibrium Diagram" plotting "Deuterium Gas Pressure - Atmospheres" (0.01 to 10,000,000) against "Concentration - D/Pd Atomic Ratio," with a family of temperature isotherm curves of "Experimentally determined D/Pd atomic ratios for a range of temperature & pressure conditions." Notes state the data are averaged over Pd samples and interpolated/extrapolated; the inner label reads "Figure 4" while the caption is "Figure 2. If the system is in equilibrium, this chart permits you to determine the pressure required to maintain a reaction at constant temperature and deuterium concentration." The page (4 of 7, BAASS, Nov-08) continues into an "Engineering Development" section.
